Happy Friday good degens!
Let’s get after it!
As always… stats/alerts/etc at top and tweets/news/links/videos/etc at bottom… and all tweets are hyperlinked so just click on them to pull them up on Twitter/X!

Oil (WTI): $91.47
US 10Y Treasury: 4.78%
Crypto Fear & Greed Index (from coinmarketcap(dot)com): 76
Biggest Price Movers
(From @coingecko top 1000, by 24 hour change)
Spotlight
Take note friends!
The gigabrain team at @DeFiSaver [ https://substack.com/redirect/975a714f-dcda-4d0f-8ac3-d5e97420d359?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] has released another cool new tool!
Once again… DeFi Saver [ https://substack.com/redirect/76fe9b73-92d0-4010-9779-2012ce135f11?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] is a trustless, non-custodial protocol aggregator that allows for efficient defi position management… 
It integrates all the major defi protocols in one intuitive UI- and provides all sorts of extremely useful tools to allow you to manage your defi activity!
Their latest shipping involves a historical Aave simulator, so you can see how positions and strategies would have performed in various circumstances!
As stated in their thread below:
“Create a simulated Aave position from scratch - or run a wallet address to find an existing position. Then, set a timeframe and simulate the results.
You can also enable these automations:
- Liquidation Protection
- Automated Leverage Management
- Stop Loss/Take Profit
 And check how they would have performed over that period….”
In addition, if you missed their recent update about their extremely cool new tool called tokensaver.fyi [ https://substack.com/redirect/f721b2cc-8d40-4fdb-b3ac-5bdedc779547?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], make sure to check it out as well by clicking here [ https://substack.com/redirect/87be9584-6435-4750-8f82-ab938574185b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]!
And as always make sure to follow them on Twitter [ https://substack.com/redirect/975a714f-dcda-4d0f-8ac3-d5e97420d359?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] for more updates, and stay tuned as we continue bringing updates on everything they are shipping!
Biggest TVL Movers + Other Interesting Data
Chains are mixed today. Top 50 chains up at least 10% on the weekly include Robinhood Chain (#11), Mantle (#20), X Layer (#26), Katana (#30), Merlin (#32), Tempo (#34), and Pharos (#44).
